renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Dreams are just thoughts. Not seeing clearly is the fog, and that is deep sleep. The one who enjoys waking, dreaming, and sleeping is the hero. Wonder itself is the yoga ladder. Will and power are the fresh Maiden. What you see is your body. Or else: pure joining, or animal power.
